personality_one_liner: A deeply reassuring, highly legible companion that feels like a caring family member, not a clinical tool.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (min 48x48pt for interactive elements) and high visual separation to reduce cognitive load.

do's: Use solid colors for high contrast and extreme readability.
dont's: Do not use blur or glass effects as they reduce perceptibility for elderly users with visual impairments.

screens.name: RoleChooser
screens.purpose: A warm, reassuring entry point asking who is using the app.
screens.layout: Massive logo at top. Two giant primary buttons ('I am using this for myself', 'I am a family member'). High contrast text.

screens.name: LoginElder
screens.purpose: Frictionless authentication for seniors using a massive keypad.
screens.layout: Large instructions. Huge numeric keypad taking up the bottom 60% of the screen. 4 massive circles for PIN input. No complex text fields.

screens.name: LoginChild
screens.purpose: Standard email/password login for the family member.
screens.layout: Standard form layout with inputs for Email, Password, and Family Link Code. Sticky submit button at bottom.

screens.name: Elder_Home
screens.purpose: Never-ending news feed combined with family updates.

states.empty: No news available, show check back later.
states.error: Could not load feed, tap to retry.

screens.layout: Top row: horizontal scroll of 'Family Updates' (big avatars of children). Below: Infinite vertical feed of news cards (large images, large text, NO category chips at top).

screens.name: Elder_Health
screens.purpose: Track medications, intake, and reorders simply.
screens.layout: Top section: 'Did you take your medicine?' with massive 'YES' and 'NOT YET' buttons. Below: List of meds with real pill images. Floating OCR capture button.

screens.name: Elder_Content
screens.purpose: Vertical video feed for Spiritual, Bhajans, and Devotional content.
screens.layout: Full-screen vertical scrolling reels layout. Simple right-side actions (Like, Share). Very obvious UI.

screens.name: Elder_Profile
screens.purpose: Simple settings and concierge request tracking.
screens.layout: List view. Prominent 'My Requests' section showing statuses like 'Requested', 'Approved by [Child Name]', 'In Progress'. Contact support.

screens.name: CallScreen
screens.layout: Massive central avatar. Big typography 'Connecting to Amit'. Three giant circular buttons at bottom: Mute, Video Toggle, End Call.

screens.name: Child_Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide the child with analytical peace of mind regarding their parent.
screens.layout: Grid of info cards: Parent's last active time, most-used feature, location snippet, medicine stock levels (highlight low stock). Slightly more data-dense than elder app.

screens.name: Child_TaskInbox
screens.purpose: Manage AI concierge requests originating from the parent.
screens.layout: List of action-required cards (e.g., 'Medicine running low - Reorder requested'). Approve / Arrange buttons. Status tracking workflow.

instructions_to_main_agent: LOGO CONCEPT: Create a vector-based layout for the 'Sunshine' logo. Avoid stock emojis. Use Ionicons 'partly-sunny' (or 'sunny-outline') interlocking with 'leaf-outline' in brandSecondary (#FFB703) and brandPrimary (#3A5A40). The wordmark should be in 'Plus Jakarta Sans' bold, maintaining a warm and reassuring feel.

COLOR PALETTE: Strict adherence to the new palette. NO orange, NO purple, NO medical blue. We are using Deep Sage Green (#3A5A40) for trust/health and Soft Marigold (#FFB703) for warmth/sunshine. Contrast is extremely important.
TYPOGRAPHY & ACCESSIBILITY: The base font size is bumped to 18pt, with 20pt and 24pt for emphasis. Weight is capped at 500. This is an elder-first app. Touch targets MUST be a minimum of 48x48pt.
NAVIGATION: 4 tabs for Elder App: Home (News), Health, Content (Reels), Profile. There are NO category chips on the Home screen to maximize screen real estate.

GLOBAL OVERLAYS (Elder App): Implement a floating SOS button (red, unmistakable but not blocking content) and a floating Voice Assistant button (mic icon, perhaps brandPrimary) present across all elder screens.
ROLES: Ensure the login flow explicitly splits between Elder (Phone + massive PIN pad) and Child (Email + Password). They lead to entirely different navigation stacks.
AI CONCIERGE LOOP: The Elder's 'My Requests' view and the Child's 'Task Inbox' must visually mirror each other's status (Requested -> Approved -> In Progress).
GLASSMORPHISM: DISABLED. Due to accessibility requirements for elderly users, rely entirely on solid colors and strict contrast boundaries instead of blurs.
